title: Setup preserves simulated tape heads
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be any configuration of the mapping machine in its non-forward setup mode, and let $i$ be one of the simulated work tapes of $M$. After one step, the head position on the tape corresponding to $i$ is unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Boolean Turing machine
c is a configuration of the mapping machine
i indexes a work tape of M
